mostWorthwhile.text: Following fat from large droplets to smaller droplets and then broken molecules was most worthwhile. It made bile's job different from the enzymes' job clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final protein combination was the least engaging: it was the only offered combination and its result was fairly predictable from the picture.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected spreading fat into droplets and breaking its molecules to be two separate jobs. The enzyme appearing at the droplet surface helped explain the sequence.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures connected the ingredients to their jobs, even when I was following an offered pairing.

continue.text: I might continue to see how the small food molecules get from the gut to the rest of the body. The digestion sequences were clear, although the final choice was predictable.
